Sobre los descuentos:
• 10% de descuento reservando online directamente con nosotros a través de la página web, no a través de terceros como PADI. Este es el descuento online estándar y se aplica automáticamente al reservar por la web.

fallos.mensaje_cliente: Hello My name is [NOMBRE], i'd like to inquiry about the modalities for a 2 day dive package at the rosario islands. i'll be heading in on april 13th and 14th leaving on the 15th in the morning. What do i need to bring. i<ll be in Cartagena, is it hard to get to your location, any advice?
fallos.respuesta_ronda:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

The Rosario Islands are a beautiful place to dive! Since you’ll be in Cartagena, the two-day option is the *4-dive package*: 4 daytime dives over April 13–14. It’s for certified divers and requires an overnight stay on the islands on the night of April 13; accommodation isn’t included and must be booked directly with a hotel. The boat returns to Cartagena on April 14 at 3:00 p.m. (around 4:15 p.m.), so it wouldn’t fit with leaving on the morning of April 15 only if you were planning to return with us on the 15th—but you can return on the 14th and stay in Cartagena overnight.

The online price is *316 USD / 1,154,000 COP per person*; the regular price is *351 USD / 1,282,000 COP per person*. The online booking link is: https://divingplanet.org/tours-buceo-snorkel-cartagena/

Bring your *diver certification card*, swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses, and comfortable clothes. Diving equipment, boat transport, park entrance, insurance, and lunch on day 1 are included. Day 2 lunch and accommodation are not included. If it’s been more than two years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required. Please also allow at least 18 hours between your last dive and a flight.

Getting to the meeting point is straightforward: meet at *Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.*, about five minutes from the historic center. There’s no hotel pickup in Cartagena, so you’ll need to arrange your own transport to the dock; ground transport isn’t included.
